My focus is on a professional, cloud-synced experience, making the manual import feel anachronistic.

Referees will now access sessions directly from the cloud within their panel, a far simpler user experience. Consequently, I'm removing the share button from the Admin panel and the import code section from the Referee panel. Also, I will remove the related methods from `storage.ts`.

I'm removing "Share Code" functionality from `storage.ts`, along with the share button from the Admin panel and the import code section from the Referee panel. The Referee panel fetches sessions directly from the cloud, making the import code unnecessary. I've also updated the storage methods for a cleaner codebase. In the cloud-synced system, these codes are indeed redundant!
